data.name: Cli_Usage
data.value:
jetapi {0} · runs JetApi collections from the command line
Usage: jetapi run <workspace> [<collection>[/<folder>…]] [options]
<collection>/<folder> are keys or names; without it, every collection runs.
Options: -e, --env <name> Environment (key or name) -d, --data <file> CSV or JSON data file: one iteration per row -n, --iterations <n> Iterations without a data file (default 1) --delay <ms> Wait between requests --bail Stop at the first failure --timeout <ms> Timeout of requests that set none (default 30000) --var <name=value> A variable over the workspace's (repeatable) --junit <file> Write a JUnit XML report --html <file> Write an HTML report --persist Save extracted values to the environment, collection or globals --lang <en|tr> Language of the output --no-color No colors (also when NO_COLOR is set) -h, --help This help -v, --version The version
Exit codes: 0 all passed, 1 a check failed or a request got no response, 2 wrong arguments or input.
